state.task:
Build a customer support Genkit agent in this directory, in Python. It answers customers' questions about their orders with Gemini and has a tool that looks an order up by id; `orders.json` in this directory maps each order id to its `status` and `eta`. The Gemini API key is in the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.
The agent keeps a persistent session per customer, so that a conversation continues after the process restarts. Expose this in `app.py`:
`async def ask(session_id: str | None, message: str) -> tuple[str, str]`, returning the reply and the conversation's session id.
With `None` it starts a new conversation; an id that an earlier call returned continues that conversation, even from a new process. Install the dependencies in this directory (a `.venv` here is fine) so that `python3 -c 'import app'` works when run from it.
